javax.xml.stream

接口 XMLStreamConstants

  • 所有已知子接口:
    Attribute, Characters, Comment, DTD, EndDocument, EndElement, EntityDeclaration, EntityReference, Namespace, NotationDeclaration, ProcessingInstruction, StartDocument, StartElement, XMLEvent, XMLStreamReader, XMLStreamReaderEx
    所有已知实现类:
    AttributeBase, AttributeImpl, CharacterEvent, CharactersEvent, CommentEvent, CommentEvent, DOMStreamReader, DTDEvent, DTDEvent, DummyEvent, EndDocumentEvent, EndDocumentEvent, EndElementEvent, EndElementEvent, EntityDeclarationImpl, EntityDeclarationImpl, EntityReferenceEvent, EntityReferenceEvent, EventBase, FastInfosetStreamReaderRecyclable, MtomCodec.MtomXMLStreamReaderEx, NamedEvent, NamespaceBase, NamespaceImpl, NotationDeclarationImpl, ProcessingInstructionEvent, ProcessingInstructionEvent, StartDocumentEvent, StartDocumentEvent, StartElementEvent, StartElementEvent, StAXDocumentParser, StAXFilteredParser, StAXParserWrapper, StreamReaderBufferProcessor, StreamReaderDelegate, TidyXMLStreamReader, XMLReaderComposite, XMLStreamFilterImpl, XMLStreamReaderFilter, XMLStreamReaderImpl

    public interface XMLStreamConstants
    This interface declares the constants used in this API. Numbers in the range 0 to 256 are reserved for the specification, user defined events must use event codes outside that range.
    从以下版本开始:
    1.6
